Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Staff Nurse position at AIIMS Delhi is August 31, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Nursing and Midwifery to be eligible for the Staff Nurse position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Staff Nurse position in this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Staff Nurse role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Staff Nurse position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse recruitment should be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job offered?
faq.answer: The job offered for the Staff Nurse position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110029.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What should be mentioned in the subject line of the email application?
faq.answer: The subject line of the email should clearly mention the post for which you are applying.
